title: Negative Pressure Wound Therapy (NPWT / Wound VAC)
description: DME MAC coverage criteria for outpatient negative pressure wound therapy (HCPCS E2402). Covered for Stage III or IV pressure ulcer, chronic neuropathic diabetic ulcer, or dehisced surgical wound failing to heal despite at least 30 days of comprehensive conventional wound care.

criteria.name: Stage III/IV Pressure Ulcer, Diabetic Ulcer, or Dehisced Wound
criteria.description: Documented full-thickness Stage III or IV pressure ulcer, chronic neuropathic diabetic foot ulcer, or open dehisced surgical wound.
criteria.source_text_excerpt: Ulcers and Wounds in the Home Setting: The beneficiary has a chronic Stage 3 or 4 pressure ulcer (see Appendices Section), neuropathic (for example, diabetic) ulcer, venous or arterial insufficiency ulcer, or a chronic (being present for at least 30 days) ulcer of mixed etiology.

criteria.name: Conventional Wound Care Trial Failure (>= 30 Days)
criteria.description: Documented trial and failure of >= 30 days of standard conventional wound care (debridement, moist dressings, offloading, pressure redistribution).
criteria.clinical_intent: Mandatory prior conventional wound therapy trial
criteria.source_text_excerpt: This shall be done to ensure that the refilled item remains reasonable and necessary, existing supplies are expected to end, and to confirm any changes or modifications to the order.

criteria.name: Untreated Osteomyelitis or Necrotic Eschar Exclusion
criteria.description: Active untreated osteomyelitis in wound bed, necrotic tissue with eschar present, or exposed visceral vasculature.
criteria.clinical_intent: Absolute contraindication to suction therapy on un-debrided necrotic tissue
criteria.source_text_excerpt: The presence in the wound of necrotic tissue with eschar, if debridement is not attempted;
